feeds.title: She Sweats Diamonds » Intentional Living
feeds.description: She Sweats Diamonds, a Dallas-based, multi-faceted lifestyle blog about luxury fashion, beauty, self-leadership, and intentional living! Learn more about living a purposeful life and get some tips and ideas on how to start living a more intentional lifestyle!

feeds.title: Intentional in Life
feeds.description: Jessica is a follower of Christ, wife, and mother of three energetic boys. She writes about homeschooling, frugal living, motherhood, intentional living and everything in between. Her heart is to inspire and encourage others to live an intentional life.

feeds.title: Financial Mechanic » Intentional Living
feeds.description: Financial freedom means you don't depend on another person, a boss, or a career for your income. Once your passive income covers your expenses, you can choose what you want to do with your life and your work. That's freedom. Learn more about it on my blog.

feeds.title: A More Intentional Life
feeds.description: A lifestyle blog about living a more intentional life. This site provides a wealth of information about living a more intentional life and how to incorporate intentional thinking into every aspect of your life.

feeds.title: Balance Through Simplicity » Intentional Living
feeds.description: Decluttering my home and simplifying my life were the changes that saved me when I was at my lowest point, struggling to juggle a young family, a busy career and a million other things all day, every day. This is a collection of blog posts and resources about intentional living. Practical tips and inspiration to help you live a life of purpose.

feeds.title: Intentional Living with Meb Blog
feeds.description: Intentional Living with Meb follows the discourses of Meb, a young sassy believing woman with a fiery zeal to open others' eyes to their inheritance in Christ. Here you'll find a compendium of articles on LifestyleNavigating singlehood and marriage, Faith confessions, and Inspiring stories for your soul.

feeds.title: La.Rue » Intentional Living
feeds.description: The Ultimate Intentional Living & Lifestyle Brand. Intentional Living is a lifestyle choice when you choose to live intentionally you actively working towards achieving your dreams and living fully. In this blog, I share my thoughts on musing and journey and strive to help others.

feeds.title: Jules Acree
feeds.description: Jules Acree specializes in creating lifestyle tools and video content that can help people design a more intentional life. With Jules' help, individuals can incorporate feel-good systems and self-care practices that create more time, space, and energy in their lives. Jules aims to simplify lives through intentional systems and rituals and help people achieve a more fulfilling and intentional life.

feeds.title: Simple + Intentional Blog
feeds.description: The author of the blog knows how hard it is and what's on the other side. She offers coaching Whether you need help decluttering your closet, creating a schedule, or digging deep into what's at the root of it all. This is a blog about living with less, being intentional, and simplifying so you can choose your life.

feeds.title: Dr Gia Marson Blog
feeds.description: The psychologist, author, consultant, integrative medicine health coach, lecturer, and longtime meditation practitioner's blog include informative articles about healthy living, healthy eating, meditation and more. Readers can follow the blog learn about coping skills and the intentional living lifestyle.

feeds.title: Planner Me Up » Intentional Living
feeds.description: I always envisioned a simple life where I didn't have to trade my time for dollars. Awaking every morning to do exactly what I love felt like every bit of a dream until I made it my reality. I deliberately planned to change my life. 'What is my purpose? What matters most to me?' I asked myself this often. This is a blog all about how I did it and how you can achieve it too.

feeds.title: Gather Intentional Living Blog
feeds.description: Empowering the everyday host with the skills they need to feel comfortable opening their doors. Gather Intentional Living is not here to guide you to perfection. Not at all. They are here to help tackle your fears and help you make your table a place of celebration again. A place of rest, peace, beauty, and confidence!

feeds.title: The Lifestyle Files
feeds.description: This a minimalist lifestyle blog that helps you make smarter choices, live a more intentional life, stay away from the clutter, turn simple moments into meaningful memories, and a Minimalist lifestyle, a maximalist attitude.

feeds.title: Antimaximalist.» Intentional Living
feeds.description: Eric Owens is the writer behind Antimaximalist. He is a simple guy constantly seeking happiness and meaning in life. He shares all the lessons he has learned in life. His blog contains tips on self-help, minimalism, and personal development. His intentional living articles aim to inspire readers to be more determined and focused on the choices they make.
